To share the sweets equally, each child needs to have the same number of sweets. First, I need to figure out how many sweets each child would have if they were shared equally. I can do this by dividing the total number of sweets (74) by the number of children (8). 74 divided by 8 is 9 with a remainder of 2. This means each child could have 9 sweets, and there would be 2 left over. To share the sweets equally, all the children need to have the same number. That means the 2 leftover sweets need to be distributed. So, I need to add 2 more sweets to the total so that 76 sweets can be divided equally among the 8 children. 76 divided by 8 is 9 with no remainder. Therefore, 2 more sweets are needed. 

Answer: 2
